title: Will and Parish
author: Hazel Reyes
blurb: Felix Pemberton, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
